title: M Tool Account
author: Theara
changelog: Fix false Checkpoint Disabled labels from diagnostic messages; tighten checkpoint detection and isolate cookie/token checks. Improve Khmer fonts, hourly text-only account backups, UID-named browser profiles and account/profile maintenance. Move Chrome/Brave/Edge selection beside Columns. Selecting a drive now uses M Tool Account/ChromeProfiles; Save Path can organize existing profiles and Bak after browsers close. Existing custom locations remain unchanged. Preserve existing verified sessions; logged-out accounts try cookies before UID/password. Recognize pending 2FA verification and preserve its page instead of restarting password login. Close tool-owned Chrome/Brave/Edge sessions on exit without closing personal browser windows. Hotmail OAuth requires your own Microsoft app setup. Live Facebook login and 2FA compatibility still require authorized-account testing.
